LESSON: HADITH ON GOOD BEHAVIOUR

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Hadith on good Behaviour

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on good Behaviour. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should one behave well?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
   In simple words: practise until you can identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
   In simple words: practise until you can discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can apply good behaviour in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on good Behaviour using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on good Behaviour in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on good Behaviour to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on good Behaviour.
4. Show that you can: identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on good Behaviour using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on good Behaviour important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the teachings and relevance of the Hadith in their daily life,
2. Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening and teamwork is enhanced as learners discuss the teachings and relevance of the Hadith in their daily life.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one behave well?
2. What actions show that you fear Allah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
